pages.title: About the practice
pages.content:
Nodoka Counselling was founded in 2014 by clinical psychologist Mira Halden as an unhurried alternative to rushed consultations. We work from the second floor of 18 Alder Row in the Riverside District, with a step-free entrance and a lift.

Today six people work here: five practitioners and an intake coordinator. We bring together integrative psychotherapy, cognitive-behavioural principles and person-centred conversation, shaped to the pace of each person.

The rooms

The rooms are arranged for acoustic privacy, window light and ease. You can meet us here over a cup of tea, or online from home.

pages.title: What we help with
pages.content:
People come to us with feelings that have grown too heavy to carry alone. Seven areas of difficulty bring most of them through the door.

  • Anxiety and worry
  • Low mood
  • Grief and loss
  • Work stress and burnout
  • Relationships and couples
  • Life changes
  • Sleep and restlessness

We are not an emergency service. If you are in danger, call your local emergency number.

pages.title: A first conversation
pages.content:
Starting does not mean committing to months of appointments. The first steps are three, and each one is yours to decide.

Before

Write or call us to arrange a free 20-minute check-in call. We learn what brings you, answer practical questions and suggest the practitioner who suits what you are looking for.

During

A 50-minute first conversation, in our room or online. Nothing needs to be prepared. The fee is EUR 70.

After

We decide together whether and how to continue. There is no obligation.

pages.title: Practitioners
pages.content:
Six people work at the practice.

  • Mira Halden, founder, clinical psychologist
  • Tomas Reyes, psychotherapist
  • Anika Voss, counsellor
  • Lin Qiao, psychotherapist
  • Samuel Okafor, counsellor
  • Hana Lindqvist, intake coordinator

When you write to us, Hana will suggest the practitioner whose way of working suits what you describe.

pages.title: Fees and hours
pages.content:
Fees (EUR)

  • Check-in call, 20 min: free
  • First conversation, 50 min: 70
  • Individual session, 50 min: 95
  • Extended session, 80 min: 140
  • Couples session, 80 min: 160
  • Online session, 50 min: 90
  • Series of five individual sessions: 450

Cancellation is free up to 24 hours before. Four sliding-scale places are kept each week.

Hours

Monday to Friday 9:00-20:00 (Thursday until 21:00), Saturday 9:00-15:00. Closed on Sundays and public holidays. We answer messages within one working day.

pages.title: Questions
pages.content:
Do I need to know what to talk about?

No. Many people arrive without an outline. We begin wherever you are.

Is what I say kept private?

Yes. We hold everything you share in strict confidence, within the limits we explain at your first conversation.

How soon can I be seen?

We reply to every enquiry within one working day, and evening slots are open on Thursdays until 21:00.

pages.title: Online sessions
pages.content:
If travelling is hard, or you prefer your own room, we offer secure video sessions of 50 minutes for EUR 90. The first conversation can also be held online.

To book, write to us or use the contact page and tell us you would like to meet online.
